stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]以下哪三项属于基于风险的方法？(选择三项.)

options.A: 进行全面的风险评估,以识别客户、交易和地域风险
options.B: 对于之前已标记的客户,重点进行监控而对于其他客户则采用标准控制措施
options.C: 选择并应用与所识别风险等级相适应的有效控制措施
options.D: 根据客户的活动和关系确定其详细的风险概况
options.E: 在所有客户群体间平均分配资源以确保公平性

stem_en: Which of the following are part of a risk-based approach? (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Performing a comprehensive risk assessment to identify customer, transaction, and geographic risks.
options_en.B: Focusing monitoring primarily on previously flagged customers while using standard controls for others.
options_en.C: Choosing and applying effective controls that align with the identified risk levels.
options_en.D: Determining detailed risk profiles for customers based on their activities and relationships.
options_en.E: Allocating resources evenly among all customer segments to ensure fairness.
